gaps.sentence: Do you get ___ well with your new colleagues?
gaps.explanation: get on (with) = have a good relationship; also get along with (AmE).

gaps.sentence: I ran ___ my old teacher at the airport.
gaps.explanation: run into somebody = meet them by chance (also: bump into).
bring down = cause a government/person to lose power; reduce (prices).

gaps.sentence: Prices levelled ___ after the crazy spring market.
gaps.explanation: level off = stop rising or falling and stay the same.

gaps.sentence: The kids made ___ a story about a stolen dog.
gaps.explanation: make up = invent (a story, excuse). Compare make up for = compensate.

gaps.sentence: During the tour she pointed ___ the oldest house in town.
gaps.explanation: point out = mention/draw attention to a fact.

gaps.sentence: Our street was cut ___ for three hours after the storm.
gaps.explanation: cut off = disconnected (power, phone); isolate (a village cut off by snow).

gaps.sentence: They broke ___ after only two years of marriage.
